notes.content:
More Store Items!
- Added 5 more items to the store
    
 Top Hat
 Evil Horns
 Sideburns
 Headphones
 Cheesy Glasses (Shoutout to @TheCheesyDad)


Optimizations!
- Added the option to clean up the dead

This option will limit the amount of people that can be dead on the screen at once. This way, you can start a battle with a large amount of people, and the lag will reduce over time as people die off.


Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Changes
- Fixed a bug preventing users from exiting the game after it finishes
- Properly change colors in the main menu
- Added version checking, letting you know when a new version of the game is released.

notes.title: Increased Customization!
notes.content:
Increased Customization!
- Added a store page to the website (www.chatfight.win)
- Added items to the store
    - Ball Cap (Backward)
    - Ball Cap (Forward
    - Holiday Helmet
    - Liberty Spikes

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug preventing users from being able to join certain channels
- Fixed a bug where some users were not seeing items in game

Main Menu UI Overhaul

- Full rework of menu UI
- Added tabs for Lobby, Leaderboards, and Settings

Bug Fixes
- Allowed users to change their channel name
- Fixed inability to rejoin a lobby after the game is finished
